generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The Item Rates quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on constructive materials & other taxes as per the rates prevailing Government Orders at the time of execution and including cost and conveyance of all materials, curing, loading and unloading with all leads and lifts, labour, hire charges of machinery & equipment etc., complete and all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer- in-charge of the work.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

As per Karnataka State Government Order LD/300/LET /2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No PW/134/BMS/2007 dated27.07.2007, a sum Amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund. Details
The Tenderer should up load the Registration Certificate through E-procurement
THE GST shall be paid saperately to the tendered amount
The KPWD Code, KTTP Act/Rules ,Delegation of Powers and other Government Orders issued by the Government from time to time will apply

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of e Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Royalty Charges will be Deducted in every bill of contract as per rules
The Employer reserves the right to Reject all Tenders without assigning any reason
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The Bidder will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value of this work
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Bid document KW 1
